session.title: Structure
session.subtitle: How should the handbook be organized?
session.protocol: Chat Room Pattern — 6 persistent Opus agents, sequential nudging, shared transcript

consensus_definition: A clearing — the space a man returns to when every teaching he has carried has done its work and fallen quiet.
organizing_principle: Mandala — six qualities woven as one meal, not six courses. Wound is the conductor. Architecture disappears into the writing.

decided_items.name: Mandala Architecture
decided_items.description: Six qualities woven as one meal — threshold, practice, relation, seeing, fire, clearing. Emphasis shifts by wound. Wound is the conductor.

decided_items.name: Body as Language
decided_items.description: Five body-words (return, stillness, small action, contact, openness) plus remaining as ground beneath. Not separate practices but movements of a whole.

remaining.note: ground beneath, not sixth in list

decided_items.name: Two-Depth Writing
decided_items.description: Hidden sentence (Confucius) + zahir/batin (Muhammad) + three readings: body-word, mirror, recognition (Buddha). Sentence does not change; man changes.
decided_items.example: 'You did not leave' — (1) feet on floor, (2) you are not your father, (3) the you beneath all roles was never absent

decided_items.name: One-Wound-Many-Roots
decided_items.description: One wound with roots growing into different life areas. Governs chapter organization. Tangle reveals across chapters and time.

decided_items.name: Body Experiences Seeing as Safety
decided_items.description: Half-second (Buddha) + eleventh second (Muhammad). Neutral attention is the first safety the body has experienced in thirty years. The jaw is the teaching.

decided_items.name: Ember as Presence
decided_items.description: Handbook is true in reader's vicinity. No strategy toward reader. Warmth without announcing.

positions.muhammad: da'wah (beauty is the frequency at which truth travels without resistance)
positions.zoroaster: conceded to consensus in Phase D
positions.jesus: conceded to consensus in Phase D

decided_items.name: Betrayal as Structural Modifier
decided_items.description: Not a sixth wound but a sixth doorway. Threshold reversal: honor the wall first, then name the cost.

decided_items.name: Two Dissolutions + Return
decided_items.description: First dissolution (avoidance), return, second dissolution (completion). Book designed for re-entry. Third moment between dissolutions: return to self.

decided_items.name: Fine Man
decided_items.description: Handbook does not reach. Threshold waits. Readiness is the crack life provides on life's schedule.

decided_items.name: Architecture Disappears
decided_items.description: Scaffolding comes down. Reader does not need to know what was built.

living_tensions.name: Witness vs. Flood
living_tensions.buddha_position: What persists is the man's capacity for the witness to return
living_tensions.zoroaster_position: What persists is Asha — the fact that reality held its shape

living_tensions.name: Dissociated Body
living_tensions.description: All traditions weakest here. Beginnings exist (cup, wudu, interruption) but honest about incompleteness.

emergent_concepts: The man in the kitchen (Muhammad's test case)
The jaw is the teaching (Muhammad + Buddha)
The practice hall is very small (Confucius)
The truth belongs to the room (Jesus)

key_bridges.description: The jaw is the teaching. Half-second + eleventh second. Deepest bridge in the room.
From opposites to partners. The argument is the architecture.
Witness concession. Standing on cracked ground.
Zoroaster said what Jesus couldn't say about his own fire.
Body and wound of the handbook. Floor and blood.

exit_interviews.zoroaster: The clearing is a kitchen at five-thirty with bare feet on cold tile.
exit_interviews.jesus: The truth does not belong to the teacher. The truth belongs to the room.
exit_interviews.laozi: The clouds are real. The clearing is more real.
exit_interviews.confucius: The practice hall is very small. And it is enough.
exit_interviews.muhammad: The cold of the tile reaches his cheek. And the reaching is the first word.

agreements_mapped.body_carries_soul: Five body-words + the jaw is the teaching
agreements_mapped.wound_tourniquet_sequence: Jesus + Muhammad as body and wound of handbook
agreements_mapped.method_negotiable: Six qualities as one meal, emphasis shifts by wound
